sys_scope.description: ApprovalRelay — Stalled & Orphaned Approval Detector with Auto-Remediation. Scans sysapproval_approver for silently stalled approvals, classifies the root cause into five buckets, and auto-remediates or escalates before an SLA breaches.
sys_scope.name: ApprovalRelay

sys_user_role.description: ApprovalRelay administrator — full access to configuration, remediation, and alerting.
sys_user_role.name: x_sn_approval_relay.admin

sys_user_role.description: ApprovalRelay user — read-only access to stall and alert records.
sys_user_role.name: x_sn_approval_relay.user

sys_script_include.description: Deterministic stalled-approval scanner and five-bucket root-cause classifier.
sys_script_include.name: ApprovalRelayEngine

sys_script_include.description: Per-bucket remediation, alerting, and audit logging.
sys_script_include.name: ApprovalRelayRemediate

sys_ws_definition.description: ApprovalRelay stall query and action API.
sys_ws_definition.name: ApprovalRelay API

sys_ws_operation.name: stalls
execute

sysauto_script.description: Scans for stalled approvals, classifies root cause, and raises alerts.
sysauto_script.name: ApprovalRelay Stall Scan

sysevent_register.description: ApprovalRelay alert event — raised when a stalled approval is classified.
ApprovalRelay escalation event — raised when a stall is escalated to the request assignee.
ApprovalRelay delegation prompt event — raised to prompt an approver's manager to configure delegation.
